DMM 253.1.2).
3. Package Quality Noncompliance Fee or Unmanifested Fee, add $0.25 per piece.
4. Dimension Noncompliance Fee, add $3.00.
5. Parcels that exceed 22 inches but not greater than 30 inches in length with DSCF Entry, add $3.50.
6. Parcels that exceed 22 inches but not greater than 30 inches in length with DDU Entry, add $2.25.
7. Parcels that exceed 22 inches but not greater than 30 inches in length with DHUB Entry, add $2.25.
8. Parcels that exceed 30 inches in length with DSCF Entry, add $8.50.
9. Parcels that exceed 30 inches in length with DDU, add $7.00.
10. Parcels that exceed 30 inches in length with DHUB, add $7.00.
11. Parcels that exceed 2 cubic feet (3456 cubic inches), with DSCF Entry, add $21.00.
12. Parcels that exceed 2 cubic feet (3456 cubic inches), with DDU Entry, add $21.00.
13. Parcels that exceed 2 cubic feet (3456 cubic inches), with DHUB Entry, add $21.00.
14. Parcels that contain any of the following characteristics with DSCF Entry, add $3.50. DDU Entry, add $2.25, DHUB Entry, add $2.25:
a. Cylindrical tubes or rolls
b. A can, or wooden or metal box
c. A parcel containing more than 24 ounces of liquid in glass containers, or 1 gallon or more of liquid in metal or plastic containers
d. Other: parcels prepared under 601.3.0 and 601.4.0 with contents that may cause the parcel to roll or not maintain the integrity of the package during
processing
15. HAZMAT Handling Fee, add $0.00.
16. HAZMAT Noncompliance Fee, add $50.00.
17. Weight unit is pounds unless otherwise indicated.
